hypotheses.title: Put-Call Open Interest Contrarian Institutional Hedge Ratio (pcr_oi_all)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Open interest represents sticky multi-month institutional positioning rather than high-frequency speculative volume. A high put-to-call open interest ratio across all option maturities indicates heavy institutional downside hedging and dealer short-gamma inventory. Selecting equities with the lowest put-to-call open interest ratio (-pcr_oi_all) isolates stocks with bullish institutional call accumulation, insulated from market maker hedging liquidation cascades.
confounders: Unhedged speculative retail call buying bubbles in distressed micro-caps
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high put-to-call open interest stocks outperform low put-to-call stocks cross-sectionally.

hypotheses.title: Options Synthetic Forward Price Cost-of-Carry Basis (forward_price_180)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Put-call parity ties the 180-day synthetic forward price to spot price, risk-free interest rates, and equity borrow fees. Equities whose synthetic forward price is depressed relative to spot reflect exorbitant short-borrow fees, institutional crowding, and expected dividend cuts. Equities with the highest forward basis ((forward_price_180 - close) / close) represent uncrowded compounders with positive carrying value and strong institutional balance-sheet support.
confounders: Sudden unexpected dividend initiations that alter forward parity pricing
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if forward basis discount fails to predict negative equity excess returns.

candidates.expression: 0.85 * signed_power(group_rank((ts_backfill(forward_price_180, 10) - close) / close, subindustry) - 0.5, 2) - 0.15 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Sell-Side Consensus Buy Recommendation Momentum (anl4_buy)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Sell-side analysts exhibit pronounced herding behavior: when an initial upgrade occurs, competing brokerage desks follow suit with confirmation upgrades over subsequent months. Measuring where current buy recommendations sit within their 120-day historical range (ts_rank(anl4_buy, 120)) captures the acceleration phase of institutional consensus upgrades, generating post-revision drift.
confounders: Stale analyst recommendations that fail to reflect sudden negative corporate news
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if 120-day high in buy recommendations is an indicator of sentiment exhaustion rather than ongoing drift.
